title: Impact of malnutrition defined by Global Leadership Initiative on Malnutrition criteria on prognosis in oral squamous cell carcinoma
html: Patients with oral squamous cell carcinoma (OSCC) may present with malnutrition prior to treatment due to oral dysfunction such as pain and dysphagia. However, limited data are available regarding the preoperative malnutrition and its prognostic impact in OSCC patients when assessed using the Global Leadership Initiative on Malnutrition (GLIM) criteria. The purpose of this study was to investigate the association between preoperative malnutrition assessed by the GLIM criteria and overall survival and disease-free survival in patients with OSCC.
